facts.fact: 插页三天日记：Day1 觉得 Slate 不对劲、Day2 他失踪一小时不肯说去哪、Day3 作者断定「那已经不是真正的 Slate」，要剖开他证明——末句「我错了」。
facts.anchor: Day 1 in the fifth. Something is up with Slate. He’s twitchy. Talking to the shadows. I don’t trust him. Day 2 in the fifth. Slate disappeared for an hour. We thought something got him. But he came back and won’t tell us where he went . . . Day 3 in the fifth. The others aren’t so sure, but I know it: that isn’t really Slate. I’m going to have to cut him open and prove it. I was wrong.

facts.fact: 醒来的第一反应是：她没有那只用来抓东西的手了，而这件事不知为何很好笑，她笑出声。
facts.anchor: I don’t have that arm anymore⁠—well, not the bottom half that does the grabbing part of things. And for some reason, that’s hilarious.

facts.fact: 左臂在肘部被包扎截齐，为了让断口干净，他们把它在肘部截掉了。
facts.anchor: my arm is bandaged off at the elbow, padded and taped tightly, though some blood has oozed through the gauze. It looks like I have even less arm than I remembered. They must’ve had to lop it off at the elbow so there would be a clean break.

facts.fact: Flint 说她被自己缝合过；她迷上的不是被救而是他说这个词时的自信与专业。
facts.anchor: He sutured me. The way he says the word⁠—so confident, so professional⁠—it makes me swoon.

facts.fact: 她含泪说「你是我的英雄」，Jade 当场反驳说自己才救了她。
facts.anchor: “You saved me.” I give a teary smile. “My hero.”

facts.fact: 清醒后她才意识到失去了整条手臂——那是种植、打绳结、制药、让她有用的手。
facts.anchor: Jade hands me her canteen. Now that I can think more clearly, it hits me: I lost my motherfucking arm. A pit forms in my stomach. My arm that I use for planting, for tying ropes, for making medicine. My arm that makes me useful.
The thought of going to the surface, trying to get a new arm that I won’t even be able to afford, and then doing this all over again seems even worse

facts.fact: Jade 在她昏迷期间勘察过：skinleech 巢靠近几条直达第六层的路。
facts.anchor: “Not far. I’ve been surveying while you’ve been resting. It seems like the skinleech nest was built close to some direct paths to the Sixth.

facts.fact: limb patch 由 Void 河豚的胰腺组织制成，除隔绝感染还会释放局部麻醉；Flint 失去腿时靠它救过。
facts.anchor: “A lot,” Flint says. “It’s made from the pancreatic tissue of Void puffer fish and emits a local anesthetic in addition to staving off infection. It saved me when I lost my leg.

facts.fact: Petra 决定留下并继续下，说自己一只手也能做，只是需要帮忙打结——话到「结」字哽住。
facts.anchor: “I’m not going back. I can do this with one arm. I’ll just need help tying⁠—” My voice breaks. Tying knots.

facts.fact: Jade 握着她肩膀承诺「我永远在这儿帮你打结」。
facts.anchor: “It’s going to be okay, Pet, I promise.” Jade grips my shoulder. “I’ll always be here to help tie your knots.”

facts.fact: 她猜 Flint 要说的是「我一直爱着你」，并把这句话在心里替他讲完。
facts.anchor: Maybe me getting mortally wounded made him realize how he really feels about me. I can’t believe I almost lost you, he’s going to say. I’ve always loved you, Petra.

facts.fact: Flint 贴耳说的第一句是「我不信任 Jade」，之后指她 tampered 自己的绳子、说 Jade 在利用她。
Flint 说出当年搬家那天他去过窗外：看见 Petra 的母亲坐在地上抱着刚断气的 Mica，以及 Petra 脸上的表情。
facts.anchor: “I knocked but no one answered, so I went around to the side and saw you through the window.” He swallows a lump in his throat. “You and your mom. I think Mica must’ve just passed, because she was on the ground holding him. And the look on your face. It was horrible.”

facts.fact: Petra 承认那几年她一直想着他，而他离开后的头几天是她人生最糟的日子。
facts.anchor: Those first few days after you left were the worst of my life.” Hours after Mica died, I went over to tap on Flint’s window. And that’s when I saw his bedroom, empty.

facts.fact: 她替寄生幼虫求情，觉得自己听得见它们要空气，Jade 把她手臂按住。
facts.anchor: My precious worm babies squirm out of the jelly. I can hear them, feel their desperation. Air, they cry, we need air. I try to wipe the jelly away so they can breathe, but Jade pins my arm down.

facts.fact: 最后一条虫被烧掉的一瞬她的哭突然停止、神志恢复，随即呕吐。
facts.anchor: When he removes the last one and tosses it into the fire, my crying abruptly stops, my mind clearing. I blink a few times, sickness churning in my gut. I lean to the side and vomit. “Six hells,” I pant. “That has to be in the top three worst Void experiences.

facts.fact: Flint 宣布不与 Jade 同行，决定离开。
facts.anchor: “I’m not diving with her,” Flint says. “I’m leaving.

facts.fact: Flint 最后一次伸手邀她同行，她道歉拒绝，他说「你在犯错」后走向出口。
facts.anchor: Flint holds out his hand for me, his eyes searching mine. “Please, Petra.”
